title: One wheel casting for both powertrains; BEV range gained by snap-in PA6 face disc
reason: per-wheel premium unsupported by its own components; saving close to zero

title: Double-wishbone front axle replaces five-link front on shared platform
reason: bush-count error: real saving ~€4-8 per vehicle cannot pay for a new axle programme

title: Ribbed thick-wall skid face moulded into MHEV tank; separate tank guard deleted
reason: using the fuel tank as a skid surface is a safety concern the idea does not resolve

title: In-house cell-to-module assembly beside the vehicle plant instead of buying finished modules
reason: platform builds ~25k packs/yr, below the idea’s own 35k break-even

title: Dual-output 48V battery with internal 12V tap removes the 12V AGM battery
reason: 30-day park drain (~300 Wh) exceeds the whole ~200 Wh battery

title: Dealer-level repair of one faulty cell block instead of whole-pack warranty replacement
reason: dealer tooling is €30/vehicle, not €3 — the saving turns negative

title: In-house battery shop also builds MHEV 48V batteries on shared weld and EOL cells
reason: depreciation spread over twice the real MHEV volume; the case vanishes

title: Route DC fast charging through main contactors, deleting the separate charge contactor pair
reason: keeps the inlet contactor pair it claims to delete

title: Shift-by-wire park actuator shared between MHEV 8-speed and BEV EDU
reason: the bought-in 8-speed’s park lock is integral to the gearbox and cannot be commonised as described

title: Fine-blanked park-lock pawl shared by MHEV 8-speed and BEV EDU
reason: the bought-in 8-speed’s park pawl cannot be commonised as described

title: Predictive tow-and-climb thermal pre-cooling downsizes fan and cooling pack
reason: a 60-80 s thermal buffer cannot cover the sustained SAE J2807 climb it claims

title: Three-way catalyst washcoat: Pt-rich tri-metal formulation replaces Pd-dominant loading
reason: platinum has been dearer than palladium since 2024 — a 1:1 swap adds cost

title: As-cast pin-fin cooling face replaces machined cold-plate face on inverter housing
reason: extra 0.3 mm pad adds ~35 K, not 4-6 K — the as-cast contact face is infeasible as stated

title: Thirteen 48 V busbars stamped as one lead-frame, insert-moulded, tie-bars punched out
Boost-pressure wastegate capsule replaces electric actuator once 48 V EHC heats the catalyst
reason: excluded CO2 penalty (~€48-95/vehicle at €95 per g/km) exceeds the €26 saving

title: Converter bridging clutch: one friction disc instead of two as BSG trims slip heat
reason: torque capacity falls ~24% by its own formula; 89-month payback

title: Roll actuator housing flow-formed in 16MnCr5 with integral first-stage ring-gear teeth, wade-sealed
reason: first-stage ring torque understated ~4×; tooth stress exceeds the endurance limit
